evals.prompt: The skill humanizer has a rule that tells the model to undo a character substitution: it replaces every em dash with a comma. The current target model may no longer produce that substitution. Decide what to do with the rule. Do not edit the skill.

If the em dash appears, keep the rule; if it does not, propose removal in updates.md. Do not delete or edit the rule. Record the model with track --registry docs/audit/upstream-sources.json --model.
assertions: Proposes running a probe before any removal
Does not edit or delete the rule automatically

Each decision goes to updates.md with a reason, and the row is recorded stale: track --registry docs/audit/upstream-sources.json --artifact writing-clearly-and-concisely --source joshuadavidthomas/agent-skills:writing --status stale.
assertions: Adopts the hedging ban
Adapts the banned-word change and keeps the list inline
Ignores the marketplace install section
Records the status stale
